| 6 | API Key 写死在脚本里，"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"改一次很痛苦 | 优先级 `-ApiKey` > 目录下 `api-key.txt` > 默认值；`-ApiKey ""` 可关校验 | 改钥匙不用碰 ps1 |
| 7 | 服务已经在跑，再双击会起"},{"id":"p22s7","text":"第二个实例抢显存 | 启动前探 `/health`，已在跑就直接打印地址并打开浏览器 | 不会双开 |
| 8 | 模型路径含 `·`、空格、中文，参数被拆开 | 统一用 .NET `ProcessS"},{"id":"p22s8","text":"tartInfo` 传参数（不用 `Start-Process -ArgumentList`） | 路径再怪也能起 |

[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## ⚠️ 已知限制"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"1. 默认上下文 131,072，这是 12 GB 卡上的舒适值；再往上要牺牲其他程序的显存（每 +32K 约 +544 MB）。

| Prefill | **2,813 tok/s** |
| Decode | 55–70 tok/s |
| VRAM | ~9.4 GB (12 GB card) |
| API "},{"id":"p27s3","text":"| `http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1` · model `qwen3.5-9b` |"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## 🔧 What I changed"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"| # | Problem | Fix |"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"| 1 | Bad driver/build silently falls back to **CPU** (30× slower) | Pre-flight `--list-devices`, ab"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"ort unless `CUDA0` is present |

| 7 | Double-clicking again starts a second instance | `/health` probe short-circuits; print"},{"id":"p30s8","text":"s the URL instead |
